text:
maya: Quick API question — for POST /v1/embeddings if we send items: ['foo', '', null, 'bar'] what should the response be for the empty string and null? preserve ordering? return null slot? I checked prod and saw an empty vector for '' and nulls got dropped in older client. Want to lock contract before SDK cut.

arjun: Historically runtime coerced null->'' and embedded, but we patched to preserve null and return null in response. That change might not be rolled everywhere.

jamie: From the model side: empty string -> model produces a valid embedding (not all zeros). null -> should be semantically different (no input). Docs should specify null preserved as null.

sam: Ops note: batch limit is 512 items per request; exceeding -> 429. Mixed types count as items. Truncation: inputs that exceed token limit for the model are truncated; we currently set an HTTP response header X-Embed-Truncated-Indices: comma-separated zero-based indices, and also an X-Embed-Model header.

lin: I thought we had per-item metadata earlier (like objects [{embedding, truncated}]) — are we keeping the array-of-vectors contract?

arjun: We must keep array-of-vectors for backward compatibility. Proposal: keep responses as an array with same length as inputs; each element is either an array of floats (embedding) or null. Add optional top-level headers: X-Embed-Truncated-Indices and X-Embed-Model. Also include a top-level field 'model' in JSON if we return JSON body metadata — but adding fields to body breaks old clients. So prefer headers.

maya: To confirm next steps: 1) keep ordering; 2) preserve nulls (return null); 3) '' gets embedded normally; 4) emit X-Embed-Truncated-Indices header when truncation occurs; 5) batch_limit = 512. Is that agreed?

jamie: :thumbsup: yes. Also note embedding dimensionality varies by model (e.g., ada-emb-1536 -> 1536 dim). We already have X-Embed-Model header so clients can infer length.

arjun: I'll open a small runtime PR to enforce null-preserve and to emit X-Embed-Truncated-Indices. Also will add a small test: input with empty string + null + long text -> expect [vec, null, vec] and header contains index 2 (0-based).

lin: Important: decide on index base in header. SDKs expect 0-based. Keep it 0-based.

maya: I can draft docs blurb: 'Requests: inputs[] may contain strings or null. Response: embeddings[] same length; null entries preserved; empty string returns embedding. Truncation indicated via X-Embed-Truncated-Indices header with zero-based indices.' I'll drop the draft in the docs PR.

sam: Ops check: rate limits per minute still apply. Also note large responses will be large in memory for 512 items; recommend stream processing in SDK.

deploy-bot: deploy/prod/runtime 2024-06-12 18:03:22 :white_check_mark: canary completed for runtime v1.42.5

maya: Thanks all — arjun, ping me when PR up and I'll review. Need docs + SDK update before next SDK cut (Thu).
